runtimeMapping.normalAttack: One ordinary caster projectile plus one drone. Trait ramp is 20%, +15% per same-target attack, capped at 110%. Target changes reset the ramp.
runtimeMapping.skill1: Selected ATK and ASPD for the source duration; ordinary caster attacks continue and release two independent locked drones.
runtimeMapping.skill2: Target-free SP_FULL activation; indefinite selected ATK and source range 3-18; caster attacks release two independent locked drones.
runtimeMapping.skill3: Ordinary caster attacks disabled; acquire legal ground or aerial inputs globally and release three independently locked drones; each hit applies source sluggish.
runtimeMapping.releasedDrone: Native Funnel preDelay .6000000238418579 scaled by current ASPD at release, followed by current attack interval. Locked projectiles read live ATK and continue beyond owner range and through owner control/disarm. Dead inputs release their slots; temporary unselectability retains the input without a damage backlog.
runtimeMapping.explosion: Each drone owns a rising .015-per-layer chance, beginning at layer one and capped at forty, with layer forty guaranteed. Failure increments its layer; self-destruction resets only that drone. One Arts AoE per exploding drone; four native aliases are cosmetic mounts. Native radius 1.100000023841858 and fixed .3199999928474426 stop-time delay use the proc position, independent of ASPD. Already emitted explosions survive owner withdrawal.
runtimeMapping.talents: Promotion/potential-selected explosion multiplier and fixed RES ignore; no explosion at E0. Explosions bypass the drone trait ramp. Counters reset on fresh deployment.
runtimeMapping.animation: Uncapped native maxAnimScale=-1. Exact delivered Front/Back event times; Back Skill2_Loop hits at .4 seconds. Original Back has no Skill3 clips and retains delivered Idle.
runtimeMapping.cleanup: Skill expiry and withdrawal clear locked drones, activation forms and stale acquisition timing. Recast starts a fresh acquisition clock.

secondaryGameplayNotes.use: Corroborates per-drone stacking explosion chance, forty-layer cap, independent counters, source range, global S3 and sluggish on explosions.

verificationLimits: Native compiled Funnel, FSM and event dispatch are unavailable; the adapter maps recovered literal fields with the local 30 Hz scheduler, not certified client frame parity.
Normal-to-released drone ramp continuity, exact native target ordering, control/acquisition callbacks and temporary-unselectability behavior remain unverified against client frames.
Explosion damage reads current ATK at the mapped stop-time callback. Native damage/missability/buff event ordering and whether ATK is sampled earlier are not certified.
Native explosion ignores camouflage; this regular-stage engine does not separately model camouflage, so that interaction is not certified. Only the two supported basic enemy kits are enabled.
Front S3 begin uses its delivered animation; Back lacks all Skill3 clips and uses delivered Idle. Native missing-clip callback timing is unverified.
Native funnel/projectile particles, explosion mounts, audio and modules are not rendered or enabled. Placeholder projectile visuals do not establish effect parity.
